column2: 母ちゃんが言ってたよ～功名を立てて出世したいなら、一生懸命勉強するしかないって
column3: My mother says that if you want to win rank and make something of yourself, the only way is to study hard.

column2: こ．．これは、うちの主人が出かける時に持っていた風呂敷包み．．どうしてあなた方の手に！？
column3: Th-this... this is the travel bundle my husband took with him when he left... How did it come to be in your hands!?

column2: 谷を通りかかった時に、ご主人の亡骸を見つけたんです。これはその遺品で．．
column3: We found your husband's body as we passed through the valley. These are the things he left behind...

column2: うう．．うう．．みんな私のせいです。あの時、行かないよう止めるべきだったのに
column3: Sob... sob... It's all my fault. I should have talked him out of going back then.

column2: 奥さん．．どうかお気を落とさずに．．包みの中身を確かめてください。足りない物はありませんか？
column3: Madam... my condolences... Please look through the bundle. Is anything missing?

column2: はるばるこれを届けてくださっただけで、私たちはもう十分に感謝しております
column3: You came all this way to bring these things back to us. We are grateful enough for that alone.

column2: はあ．．何もかも、この紫金葫蘆のせいなのです
column3: Sigh... It was all because of this Violet Gourd.

column2: この葫蘆に何か問題でもあるの？
column3: Is something wrong with this gourd?

column2: いいえ．．お嬢さん、誤解なさらないで。この葫蘆は主人がある墓荒らしから買い取った物で、太古の神器だと聞いております
column3: No... please don't misunderstand, Miss. My husband bought this gourd from a grave robber. It is said to be a sacred relic from ancient times.

column2: 主人がこの葫蘆を手に入れてから、家は何度も妖魔に襲われました。その後、揚州に高値で買いたいという人がいると聞いて、主人は値段の相談に出かけたのですが、まさか．．こんな．．
column3: Ever since my husband got this gourd, our home was beset by fiends again and again. Then we heard that someone in Yangzhou would pay a high price for it, so my husband went to talk terms. Who would have thought... that he...

column2: 妖魔！？　きっと．．この葫蘆は神霊の器か、さもなきゃ不吉な代物だな
column3: Fiends!? Then surely... this gourd is either a vessel of the gods or a thing of ill omen.

column2: 主人から聞いたことがあります．．紫金葫蘆は、仙術の使える方が持てば、大変な威力の宝になるのだと
column3: I once heard my husband say... that in the hands of someone who knows Magic, the Violet Gourd would be a truly formidable treasure.

column2: 女子供の私たちが持っていても役に立ちません。お二人がお嫌でなければ、この紫金葫蘆を差し上げたいのですが．．
column3: It is of no use to a mere woman and child like us. If you two heroes do not mind, I would like to make you a gift of this Violet Gourd...

column2: 紫金葫蘆を手に入れた
column3: Got Violet Gourd

column2: 葫蘆の底に文字が刻まれています。これを使うための呪文だそうですが、あいにく私たちは法術ができないので、使えないのです
column3: There is some writing on the bottom of the gourd. It is said to be the incantation for using it, but sadly we know no magic and cannot use it.

column2: へえ？　ちょっと見せてくれ．．
column3: Oh? Let me have a look...

column2: 霊葫呪を手に入れた
column3: Got Spirit Gourd

column2: 宋氏：
column3: Madam Song:

column2: うう．．私はなんて哀れなの
column3: Sob... poor, poor me...

column2: おぬしら、白苗族の者か？
column3: So you are people of the White Miao?

column2: 石長老．．降参なさい！　これだけの人数には勝てませんわ。姫様を私たちにお渡しなさい
column3: Elder Shi... surrender! You cannot beat this many of us. Hand Her Highness the Princess over to us.

column2: ふん～おぬしらごとき腐れ女どもがか？
column3: Hmph... A pack of stinking wenches like you?

column2: 姫様．．お駕籠の中においでなのは存じております。お姿をお見せ願えませんか？
column3: Your Highness... I know you are inside the sedan chair. Will you not show yourself?

column2: 姫様の漢人のご友人お二人も、すでにお招きしてあります。今は宿屋の中でお休みですわ．．きっとお会いになりたいでしょう？
column3: Your Highness's two Han friends are already our guests as well. They are resting inside the inn at this very moment... Surely you would like to see them?

column2: 逍遥お兄ちゃん．．なのですか！？
column3: Is it... Brother Xiaoyao!?

column2: はい．．わが族長の命により、姫様とご友人の方々を大理の城へお客様としてお招きしたいのです
column3: Yes... By order of our chief, we wish to invite Your Highness and your friends to the city of Dali as our guests.

column2: 寝言を申すな！
column3: Dream on!

column2: お～のれ．．
column3: Curse... you...

column2: 石長老．．いくらあなたが神通広大でも、一度にこれだけの人数を相手にしては、法力もいずれ尽きますわ．．
column3: Elder Shi... however mighty your powers, with this many of us to deal with at once, your magic is bound to run dry in the end...

column2: そのお年で、あんな残虐非道な巫王のために命を張ることもないでしょう？
column3: At your great age, there is no call to throw your life away for that cruel and lawless Witch King, is there?

column2: ふん！　わが大王を侮辱するでない
column3: Hmph! I will not hear you insult our King!

column2: 苗疆で知らぬ者はおりません。巫王は讒言を信じ、拝月教の魔功を修練したあげく気が暴走し、命は風前の灯。しかも大統を継ぐ世継ぎもいない
column3: Everyone in the Miao lands knows it: the Witch King gave ear to slander and practiced the demonic arts of the Moon-Worship Cult until his qi ran wild. Now his life hangs by a thread, and he has no heir to succeed him.

column2: 今になって、十年前に自らの手で迫害し、流浪の身へ追いやった妻と実の娘を思い出したというわけね．．ふん～
column3: And only now does he remember the wife and the daughter of his own blood whom he persecuted with his own hands ten years ago and drove into exile... Hmph.

column2: これはわが一族の内輪の事じゃ。他の部族に口を出す権利はない！
column3: This is a family matter of our own tribe. No other tribe has any right to meddle!

column2: 私たち白苗族のしきたりでは～夫と別れた妻子は、当然、母方の実家が引き取って養うものです。
column3: By the custom of us White Miao, a wife and child who have parted from the husband are naturally taken in by the mother's family.

column2: 巫后様はもともとわが白苗の大祭司。私どもが族長の命を受け、巫后様のご息女を大理へお迎えするのは、名分の立った正当な事ですわ
column3: Her Majesty the Witch Queen was once High Priestess of our White Miao. For us to bring her daughter home to Dali at our chief's command is entirely right and proper.

column2: 屁理屈を申すな！　姫様はわが南詔国ただ一人の正統な継承者。おぬしらは明らかに姫様を人質に取り、わが大王を脅すつもりであろう
column3: Sophistry! The Princess is the one rightful heir of our kingdom of Nanzhao. You plainly mean to take her hostage and threaten our King!

column2: あら～そのお言葉は心外ですわ。私たちにそんな度胸があるものですか
column3: My, what a hurtful thing to say. Where would we ever find the nerve for that?

column2: 長老たる身、たとえ死んでも、おぬしらの思い通りにはさせぬ
column3: As an Elder, even if it costs me my life, I will never let you have your way.

column2: あら～追い詰められた獣の悪あがきかしら？
column3: Oh my... The last struggle of a cornered beast?

column2: わしの最後の奥義、受けてみよ！
column3: Taste this old man's final technique!

column2: 赤血毒焔~50
column3: Crimson Blood Flame~50

column2: お二人様ですか？　どうぞこちらへお掛けください．．
column3: A party of two? Please, have a seat over here...

column2: あら～うふふ～若夫婦で物見遊山ですか？　本当にうらやましいこと．．
column3: Oh my, hoho... A young married couple out seeing the sights? How I envy you...

column2: うふ．．冗談はこのくらいにして、お二人とも何になさいます？
column3: Hoho... joking aside, what will the two of you have?

column2: 女将さん～酒はあるかい？
column3: Ma'am, have you got any wine?

column2: うちの年代物の茅台酒は、遠くまで評判なんですよ！
column3: Our aged Maotai is famous far and wide!

column2: よし～体が温まるように二本頼む。この店の自慢の酒の肴は何だい？
column3: Good, bring us two jugs to warm ourselves up. And what's the house specialty to go with it?

column2: 当店一番の自慢は蜜漬けの燻製ハムですが、お口に合いますかどうか
column3: Our finest dish is honey-glazed smoked ham. I wonder if it would suit your taste?

column2: いいね．．一皿くれ！
column3: Sounds good... one plate of that!

column2: ただいまお持ちします！
column3: Coming right up!

column2: 山の中のひなびた店ってのも、また一味違っていいもんだな
column3: A rustic inn out in the mountains has a charm all its own.

column2: この宿屋、新しくできたみたいね。去年、都へ行く時にここを通ったけど、こんな店は見かけなかったわ
column3: This inn seems to be newly opened. When I passed through here on my way to the Capital last year, I never saw it.

column2: あの～少侠さまは何とお呼びすれば？　お国はどちらですの？
column3: May I ask what I should call you, young hero? And where do you hail from?

column2: 姓は李．．余杭県の者だ
column3: The name is Li... from Yuhang County.

column2: まあ～余杭ですって．．．そんな遠くからいらしたの！　もしかして～お二人は．．奥様の里帰り？
column3: My, Yuhang... You have come from so far away! Could it be... that you two are on a visit to the bride's family?

column2: いやいや．．姐さん、冗談がうまいな。俺たちは人を捜しに出てきたんだ
column3: No, no... you do love your jokes, ma'am. We are on the road looking for someone.

column2: うふ～それじゃ、あたしの見当違いね！
column3: Hoho, then I guessed wrong!

column2: あたしはね～蓋羅嬌というの。ここの娘たちはね．．みんな、あたしと一緒に故郷の大理から中原へ出稼ぎに来たのよ
column3: As for me, my name is Gai Luojiao. These sisters who work for me... all came with me from our home in Dali to make a living in the Central Plains.

column2: ここ数年ね．．苗疆は戦乱続きで、嶺南へ移る者もいれば、中原へ出稼ぎに来る者も多いの。あたしたちは天下が太平になってから故郷へ帰るつもりよ
column3: These last few years... the Miao lands have known nothing but war. Many people have either moved to Lingnan or come to the Central Plains to make a living. We mean to go home once the world is at peace.

column2: なるほど．．どうりで店じゅう苗族の娘ばかりで、酒も料理も西南の辺境の名物ってわけだ
column3: I see... no wonder everyone in this inn is a Miao girl, and even the wine and the food are specialties of the southwestern frontier.

column2: うふふ～お気に召したら、どうぞたくさん召し上がれ
column3: Hoho... If you like it, please eat and drink your fill.

column2: 姐さん！　奴らが来ました
column3: Big Sister! They're here!

column2: ええ．．そろそろ頃合いね！
column3: Mm... it should be about time!

column2: ごめんなさいね、大事なお客様が着いたので、お二人のお相手ができなくなったわ．．お二人はどうぞ．．少しの間お休みなさいな！
column3: I'm sorry, an important guest of mine has arrived, so I can't keep you company... Why don't you two... take a little nap!

column2: 全員に知らせなさい、大物が網にかかったわ
column3: Tell everyone: the big fish is in the net.

column2: いずこの妖魔か、ここで狼藉を働くとは！　許してはおけぬ．．．飛剣を受けよ
column3: What fiend dares to run amok here! You shall not be spared... Behold my flying sword!

column2: 違います！　あの人たちは、わたしが殺したのではありません！
column3: No! I was not the one who killed them!

column2: 屋外から悲鳴が一声響いた後\n"再び静寂が戻った．．"
column3: A cry of alarm rang out from outside,\n"then all fell silent once more..."

column2: 李逍遥：\n霊児！　霊児の声だ！
column3: Li Xiaoyao:\nLing'er! That's Ling'er's voice!

column2: この者はすでに死んでいる．．
column3: This one is already dead...

column2: 李逍遥は蓋羅嬌を介抱して目覚めさせた
column3: Li Xiaoyao revives Gai Luojiao.

column2: うふ～さっきはごめんなさいね、あなたたちに眠り薬を盛ったりして。でも．．悪気はなかったのよ
column3: Hoho... I am sorry about earlier, drugging you like that. But... we meant you no harm.

column2: ご覧の通り、あなたたちをこの戦いに巻き込みたくなかったから、少しばかり手を使わせてもらったの。李少侠、どうか悪く思わないで
column3: As you can see, we did not want you drawn into this fight, so we used a little trick. I hope you will not hold it against us, young hero Li.

column2: 女将さん．．さっき．．この死んだ連中のほかに、女の子が一人いなかったか？
column3: Ma'am... just now... besides these dead men, wasn't there a girl here too?

column2: 姫様は、青い衣に白髪の老道士に連れて行かれたわ
column3: Her Highness the Princess was taken away by an old white-haired Taoist in blue robes.

column2: 姫様．．？
column3: Princess...?

column2: あなたが捜している趙霊児のことよ。あなたたちのことは、ずいぶん前から調べていたの。だから、ここを通ることも知っていたわ
column3: The very Zhao Ling'er you are looking for. I have been looking into the two of you for a long time, which is how I knew you would pass this way.

column2: じゃあ．．霊児を連れて行ったのが誰か、知ってるのか？
column3: Then... do you know who it was that took Ling'er?

column2: あの老道士は独孤剣聖と名乗っていたわ。あたしは石長老の赤血毒焔を受けて、姫様が連れて行かれるのをただ見ているしかなくて．．
column3: That old Taoist called himself Sword Saint Dugu. I had been struck by Elder Shi's Crimson Blood Flame, and could only watch helplessly as Her Highness...

column2: 剣聖殿は昔から悪を仇のように憎む、まっすぐなお方で、武林の同道たちから敬われてきたわ。霊児さんがあの方に助けられたのなら、災いどころかむしろ幸いのはずよ。李兄さん．．あたしたち、安心していいと思うわ
column3: The Sword Saint has always hated evil like a mortal enemy. He is an upright man, long revered by everyone in the martial world. If Sister Ling'er was rescued by him, it should be a blessing, not a misfortune. Brother Li... I think we can set our minds at ease.

column2: はあ．．そうだといいけどな。ただ．．
column3: Sigh... I hope so. It's just...

column2: 任務も果たせないうえに、こんな事態にしてしまうなんて。どうやら～大理へ戻って、族長にお詫びするしかないわね
column3: I failed my mission and let things come to this besides. It seems all I can do is go back to Dali and beg our chief's pardon.

column2: はあ．．霊児がすぐそばまで来てたってのに、またこうして離れ離れか
column3: Sigh... Ling'er was right there, so close to us, and yet we've been parted like this again.

column2: 李兄さん～ここは都から遠くないわ。あたしのおばが住んでいるから、ついでに会いに行きたいんだけど、いい？
column3: Brother Li, the Capital isn't far from here. I have an aunt who lives there, and I'd like to drop in on her on the way. All right?

column2: ああ、いいぜ．．
column3: Sure, why not...

column2: おいしいサンザシ飴だよ．．お安くしとくよ～
column3: Tasty Candied Haws... going cheap!

column2: 一本30文だよ、お金が足りないねえ
column3: They're 30 coins a stick. You don't have enough money.

column2: 雲おばさま、月如がご挨拶に参りました。近頃お体の具合はいかがですか？
column3: Aunt Yun, Yueru has come to pay her respects. Have you been keeping well lately?

column2: よしよし～この子ったら．．何年か見ないうちに、いっそう器量よしになって。この分なら．．嫁のもらい手に困ることはなさそうね
column3: There's a good girl... Just look at you, child. A few years out of my sight and you have grown prettier than ever. At this rate... there is no fear of your not finding a husband.

column2: 雲おばさま．．また人をからかって．．
column3: Aunt Yun... you're teasing me again...

column2: こちらが李殿かしら？
column3: And this would be Young Master Li?

column2: はい～若輩者の李逍遥と申します。奥様にご挨拶申し上げます
column3: Yes, ma'am. Your junior, Li Xiaoyao. It is an honor to meet you, Madam.

column2: そんな他人行儀はよして、あなたも雲おばさまと呼んでくれればいいのよ。私は昔から月如を実の娘のように思っているの。だから、みんな家族同然よ
column3: Don't be so formal. You may call me Aunt Yun too. I have always looked on Yueru as my own daughter, so we are all one family here.

column2: 雲おばさま～どうしてそんなこと言うのよ。あたしとこいつは、まだ何も．．
column3: Aunt Yun, why would you say such a thing? He and I haven't...

column2: まだでも～もうすぐでしょう？
column3: Not yet... but soon enough, surely?

column2: あなたのことは、晋元からみんな聞いたわ。ふふ．．あなたは小さい頃から勝ち気で、負けず嫌いだったものね
column3: Jinyuan has told me all about you. Hoho... Even as a little girl you were headstrong and could not bear to lose.

column2: この李殿が婿選びの武芸試合であなたの心を射止めたのなら、きっと武芸の腕は大したものなのでしょうね
column3: For Young Master Li to have won your heart at the martial contest for your hand, his skill must be remarkable indeed.

column2: そんなことないわ～こいつったら．．技の一つ二つを知ってるだけよ。あたしが本気で戦ったら、あたしの相手になんかならないんだから
column3: Hardly! Him? He only knows a move or two. If I had fought in earnest, he would have been no match for me.

column2: え？　その言い方だと、まるでわざと俺に勝たせてくれたみたいじゃないか？
column3: Eh? You make it sound as if you let me win on purpose.

column2: ふん～その通りよ！　この道中、あたしがいなかったら、あんたなんかとっくに妖怪に食べられてたわ
column3: Hmph, that's exactly how it was! If not for me on this journey, the demons would have eaten you long ago.

column2: 少しは俺の顔を立ててくれよ。いつも人前で恥をかかせやがって
column3: Can't you let me save a little face? You're always taking the wind out of my sails in front of people.

column2: はいはい．．二人とも口げんかはおよしなさい
column3: There, there... stop your bickering, you two.

column2: 月如．．あなたはそういう性分なのよ。理があると見れば容赦しないし、口は減らないし。この癖はどうしていつまでも直らないのかしら
column3: Yueru... that is just your nature: once you are in the right you never let up, and you have a sharp tongue. Why can you never mend that fault?

column2: 雲おばさま．．！
column3: Aunt Yun...!

column2: ふふ～でも．．やっぱりそういう月如のほうが可愛いわ
column3: Hoho... but still... Yueru is at her most lovable just as she is.

column2: はあ．．晋元にはその福がなかったのね。昔、おばさまはあなたがうちの嫁になってくれたらと、どれほど願ったことか。あなたがこの劉家に嫁いできてくれたら、どんなによかったか．．
column3: Sigh... Jinyuan simply was not so blessed. How your Aunt Yun used to hope you would become our daughter-in-law. If only you could have married into our Liu family, how wonderful it would have been...

column2: あたし、小さい頃からずっと晋元兄さんのことは実の兄のように思ってきたから、そういうことは考えたこともなかったの
column3: Ever since I was little I've thought of Brother Jinyuan as my own big brother. I never thought of him in that way.

column2: 分かっているわ．．晋元は性格が大人しすぎるから、あなたの好みではないでしょうね
column3: I know... Jinyuan is far too gentle and bookish. He would never be to your liking.

column2: そうだわ！　晋元兄さんの姿が見えないけど、どうしたの？
column3: Oh, that's right! Why don't I see Brother Jinyuan anywhere?

column2: 晋元はこの前蘇州から帰ってきてから、妙な病にかかってしまって。大勢のお医者様に診せたけれど、誰も病の原因が分からないの
column3: Ever since Jinyuan came back from Suzhou last time, he has been stricken with a strange illness. We have called in a great many doctors, but none can find the cause.

column2: このひと月は、裏の花園の離れで静養させているのよ
column3: For this past month I have had him resting quietly in the side chamber in the rear garden.

column2: ええ～病気なの！？　お見舞いに行ってもいい？
column3: What, he's ill!? May I go and see him?

column2: もちろんよ。あなたが会いに行けば、あの子もきっと喜ぶわ
column3: Of course you may. He will surely be delighted to see you.

column2: 近頃、裏の花園に珍しい牡丹をたくさん植えたの。花が咲きそろうと、それは美しいのよ。あなたたちもぜひ見ていらっしゃい
column3: We have lately planted many rare and precious peonies in the rear garden. They are a lovely sight in full bloom. You really should go and admire them.

column2: もう厨房に食事の支度をさせているわ。あなたたち、ぜひ食べていってちょうだいね
column3: I have already told the kitchen to prepare a meal. You simply must stay and dine with us.

column2: 晋元には会えたかしら？　あの子、今日はもう薬を飲んだ？
column3: Did you see Jinyuan? Has he taken his medicine today?

column2: 旦那様はもうお休みになりました。お二方、まだご用がおありでしたら、また明日おいでくださいませ
column3: My husband is already asleep. If you two still have business with him, please come again tomorrow.

column2: お二方、まだ何かご用でしょうか？
column3: Is there something else you need?

column2: うう．．ああ．．苦しい。彩依．．彩依！
column3: Ugh... aah... the pain... Caiyi... Caiyi!

column2: あいつ．．どうしたんだ！？
column3: What... what's wrong with him!?

column2: ああ！　旦那様、申し訳ございません。わたくしの戻りが遅くなりました。すぐにお薬をお持ちいたします
column3: Ah! My husband, I am so sorry. I was late coming back. I will give you your medicine at once.

column2: 旦那様．．お加減はいかがですか？
column3: My husband... how do you feel now?

column2: ふう．．少し楽になった
column3: Whew... that is a little better.

column2: だが、こんなに長く薬を飲んでいるのに、発作のたびに前より苦しくなる。私の病は本当に治るのだろうか？
column3: Yet I have been taking this medicine for so long, and each attack is harder to bear than the last. Can this illness of mine truly be cured?

column2: 旦那様、どうかご辛抱ください。あと幾日かすれば、きっとよくなられると、わたくしは信じております．．
column3: My husband, you must bear with it. I believe that in just a few more days you will be well again...

column2: 旦那様！？
column3: 'My husband'!?

column2: 劉兄さん、いつの間にこんなきれいな奥さんをもらったの？　どうしてあたしに知らせてくれなかったのよ
column3: Brother Liu, when did you take such a beautiful wife? Why did you never send word to your little sister?

column2: それは．．．話せば長くなる。
column3: That... is a long story.

column2: 劉兄さん、いったい何の病気なの？　あたしたち、道中で名医と何人か知り合ったから、力になれるかもしれないわ
column3: Brother Liu, just what illness do you have? We met some famous physicians on our travels. Perhaps they could be of help.

column2: はあ．．いや、結構だ。君たちの気持ちだけありがたく受け取っておくよ。
column3: Sigh... there is no need. I am grateful for the thought all the same.

column2: 父上と母上はもう数えきれないほど医者を呼んだが～私が何の病なのかさえ突き止められなかった
column3: Father and Mother have called in more doctors than I can count, yet not one could even tell what illness I have.

column2: 幸い、彩依が故郷から持ってきた処方のおかげで、近頃ようやく少し持ち直したんだ
column3: Fortunately, thanks to a remedy Caiyi brought from her home, I have lately begun to improve a little.

column2: 奥さんはどこの生まれなんだい？
column3: Where are you from, ma'am?

column2: わたくしの両親は蘇州府の者でございます
column3: My parents are from Suzhou Prefecture.

column2: え？　あなたも蘇州の城下に住んでたの！　あたし、一度も見かけたことないけど
column3: Hm? You lived in Suzhou too! How is it I've never once seen you?

column2: わたくし．．．．
向こうは名家の箱入り娘で、屋敷から一歩も出ないんだ。お前に毎日見られるわけないだろ
column3: She's a well-bred daughter of a good family who never sets foot outside her door. How would she be out where you could see her every day?

column2: それ、あたしへの当てつけ！？
column3: Is that meant as a dig at me!?

column2: 失礼いたします。旦那様はお薬の後、静かにお休みにならねばなりません。お話は明日、改めて旦那様となさってくださいませ
column3: Forgive me. After his medicine my husband needs peace and rest. Please save your talk with him for tomorrow.

column2: おっと！　じゃあ、俺たちはこれで失礼するよ
column3: Oh! Then we won't disturb you any longer.

column2: 何のおもてなしもできず、本当に申し訳ございません
column3: I am truly sorry I could not receive you properly.

column2: お情け深い旦那様、奥様、どうかお恵みを。もう三日も何も食べておりません～
column3: Kind sir, kind lady, spare a few coins. I haven't eaten in three days...

column2: 見たところ耳も目も達者で、手足も揃ってるじゃない。稼ぐ道はいくらでもあるのに、どうして自分から落ちぶれて道端で物乞いなんかしてるの？
column3: Your ears and eyes are sharp and all four limbs are sound. There are plenty of ways to earn a living, so why sink so low as to beg in the street?

column2: うう．．お嬢様はご存じないのです。手前の家は火事に遭い、一文無しになってしまいました
column3: Sob... you don't know the half of it, Miss. My house burned down and left me without a coin to my name.

column2: そのうえ労咳を患い、両足もごろつきに殴られて不自由になり、口を糊する仕事を探そうにも、雇ってくれる店が一軒もないのです
column3: On top of that I caught consumption, and thugs beat me until both my legs were lame. Even when I look for work to keep body and soul together, not one shop will take me on.

column2: あなた．．身寄りはいないの？
column3: Have you... no family at all?

column2: 連れ添った妻が一人おりますが、貧乏を嫌って金になびき、手前が落ちぶれた時に夫も子も捨てて、妓楼へ行って身を売っております
column3: I have a wedded wife, but she scorns the poor and loves the rich. When I fell on hard times she abandoned husband and child and ran off to sell herself in a brothel.

column2: そんな人がいるの？　ひどすぎるわ！
column3: There are people like that? That's outrageous!

column2: そうなんです～若様、お嬢様．．どうかこの哀れな者にお情けを
column3: It's true... young master, Miss... please take pity on a poor wretch.

column2: 奥さんは何という名前？
column3: What is your wife's name?

column2: 蘇氏と申します．．怡紅院での源氏名は"鶯鶯"でございます
column3: She is of the Su family... At Yihong House she goes by the name "Yingying".

column2: うう．．この胸の内を誰が知ろうか
column3: Sob... who knows the sorrows of my heart...

column2: 若様、人違いですわ。あたしはただのお茶くみで、お客は取りません
column3: You have the wrong girl, sir. I only pour the tea. I don't take customers.

column2: 鶯鶯夫人をお探しですか？　左のいちばん奥の部屋におりますよ
column3: You are looking for Madam Yingying? She is in the innermost room on the left.

column2: お客様．．ほかのお客様の部屋へ勝手に入らないでくださいまし
column3: Sir... please don't go barging into other guests' rooms.

column2: 若様．．出て行ってくださいな。私たちの邪魔をしないで
column3: Sir... please leave. Don't interrupt our business.

column2: 妓楼の客：そうだ．．この俺様は銀百両を払ったんだ。鶯鶯は今日一日まるごと俺のものだ、お前は引っ込んでろ！
column3: Brothel Patron: That's right... I paid a hundred taels of silver. Miss Yingying is mine for the whole day, so get lost!

column2: 話が済んだらすぐ帰る。鶯鶯さん．．あんたの旦那のことで来たんだ
column3: I'll go as soon as I've said my piece. Miss Yingying... I've come about your husband.

column2: あの人の！？　．．分かったわ
column3: About him!? ...Very well.

column2: 部屋の外で少し待っていて。服を着たらすぐ行くから
column3: Please wait outside the door a moment. I'll come as soon as I'm dressed.

column2: 鶯鶯に何の話があるってんだ？
column3: What business have you got with Miss Yingying?

column2: 話すならさっさと済ませろ！　この俺様の興をそぐんじゃねえ。こっちは大枚の銀をはたいてるんだ
column3: If you've got to talk, make it quick! Don't go spoiling my fun. I've laid out a great deal of silver here.

column2: 言いなさいよ．．あの人、今度はいくら借りたの？
column3: Out with it... how much does he owe this time?

column2: 金！？　俺が来たわけを誤解してるよ
column3: Money!? You've mistaken why I'm here.

column2: 借金取りじゃないの？
column3: You're not here to collect a debt?

column2: 違う．．あんたの旦那が道で物乞いしてるのを見たんだ。病気で足も不自由で、ひどく哀れだった。あんたは妻の身で、なぜ彼を見捨てておくんだ
column3: No... I saw your husband begging in the street, sick and crippled, a pitiful sight. You are his wife. Why have you abandoned him?

column2: 笑わせないで！　私があの人を見捨てた？　あの人も考えてみればいいのよ。私がここで身も心も売って、作り笑いを振りまき、恥を忍んで生き長らえているのは、誰のせいなの？　私が稼いで借金を返してやらなかったら、あの人はとっくに殴り殺されていたわ！
column3: Don't make me laugh! I abandoned him? Let him stop and think: who was it that drove me to sell body and soul in this place, to smile at every man and live on in shame? If I had not earned the money to pay off his debts, he would have been beaten to death long ago!

column2: あのろくでなしは金が入るとすぐ阿片を吸いに行って、家の財産を吸い尽くしてもまだ足りず、娘まで売り飛ばして．．私．．うう～
column3: That good-for-nothing runs off to smoke opium the moment he has any money. Smoking away everything we owned was not enough for him; he even sold our daughter... I... sob...

column2: 分かった。俺があんたの代わりに落とし前をつけさせる。じゃあ．．
column3: I understand. I'll see that you get justice. Farewell...

column2: あなた．．あの人をどうするつもり？　あの人を傷つけないで．．
column3: You... what do you mean to do to him? Please don't hurt him...

column2: あんたの奥さんに会ってきたぜ。でも．．話はあんたの言ってたのとは違うみたいだな
column3: I've seen your wife. But... it seems things aren't quite the way you told them.

column2: あんたたち．．本当に．．怡紅院までうちの女房に会いに行ったのか！
column3: You... you really... went to Yihong House to find my wife!

column2: 彼女の言う通りなら、あんたが乞食をしてるのは自業自得だ。同情する値打ちもない！
column3: If what she says is true, then you brought your beggary on yourself. You don't deserve any pity!

column2: 自分の女房と娘に身を売らせるなんて、そんな奴は飢え死にして当然よ！
column3: Forcing your own wife and daughter to sell themselves... a man like that deserves to starve!

column2: 濡れ衣だ．．！　確かに娘は売りましたが、女房を妓楼へやったりはしてませんよ！
column3: I'm wronged...! It's true I sold my daughter, but I never sent my wife to the brothel!

column2: へえ！？
column3: Oh!?

column2: あいつが自分で言ったんです．．娘はまだ小さすぎるから、自分が娘の身代わりになると．．
column3: She said it herself... that our daughter was still too young, and that she would go in her place...

column2: 何ですって！　それならなおさら死んで当然よ！
column3: What! Then you deserve to die all the more!

column2: ひいい．．お助けを！
column3: Waaah... spare me!

column2: 月如、よせ！　こいつはもう十分哀れなんだ。そんなことしたら、弱い者いじめになっちまうだろ
column3: Yueru, stop it! He's wretched enough already. Carry on like this and you'll just be bullying him.

column2: こんな卑劣な話、知らなければそれまでだけど、知ってしまったからには、黙って見ていられるわけないでしょ！？
column3: A rotten business like this... if I'd never known, that would be that, but now that I do know, how can I just stand by!?

column2: お前の家も劉家もあんなに金も力もあるんだ。ちょっと人助けするくらい、難しくないだろ？
column3: Your family and the Lius are so rich and powerful. Surely lending someone a hand wouldn't be hard?

column2: 相手によるわよ！
column3: That depends on who it is!

column2: うう．．私が悪かった、ぶたないでくれ
column3: Sob... I was wrong, don't hit me.

column2: お母ちゃん．．お茶．．
column3: Mama... have some tea...

column2: 若様のお気持ち．．ありがたくいただいておきます。これは私たちの家の内輪事、他人様にはなかなか判断のつかないことですから
column3: I am grateful for your kindness, sir... but this is our own family's affair, and it is hard for an outsider to judge.

column2: かわいそうなのは、この良い子の娘のほう．．
column3: The one to be pitied is this good daughter of mine...

column2: 金をくれないのか～呪ってやる．．嫁に行けば亭主は禿げ頭、産んだ息子は尻の穴なしだ
column3: No money for me? Then I curse you... May you marry a bald husband and bear a son with no bunghole!

column2: お優しいお嬢様．．どうかお恵みを
column3: Kind young lady... spare me a few coins.

column2: これっぽっちですか！　お嬢様．．乞食にも乞食の誇りってものがあるんですよ。近頃は物価の上がるのが早くて、これっぽっちじゃ豆腐一丁も買えやしません
column3: Is that all! Miss... even a beggar has a beggar's pride. Prices go up fast these days; this little bit won't even buy a block of tofu.

column2: へえ～じゃあ、いくら欲しいの？
column3: Oh? Then how much do you want?

column2: もしお手持ちの金の半分をくださるなら、とっておきの大きな秘密をお教えしますよ
column3: If you give me half the money you have on you, I'll tell you a great secret.

column2: なんて気前のいい！　よし～もっと近くへ。このとびきりの秘密をお教えしましょう．．
column3: How generous of you! All right, come closer, and I'll tell you this tremendous secret...

column2: 劉尚書の若様が、近頃、天女のように美しい嫁をもらったでしょう？
column3: You know how Minister Liu's son recently took a bride as lovely as a goddess?

column2: その若奥様がどれほど美しいかというと、聞くところでは～男がもう一目余計に見ただけで、魂まで吸い取られちまうそうで
column3: As for just how beautiful young Madam Liu is... they say a man need only look at her a moment too long and she'll draw the very soul out of him.

column2: それに～あの方の体からはいつも、うっとりするような花の香りが漂っていて、そばを通った者は誰もかれも心を奪われちまうんです
column3: What's more, an intoxicating scent of flowers is always drifting from her, and no one who passes her by fails to lose his head.

column2: へへ～奇妙なことに．．劉の若様は嫁をもらってからというもの、体が日に日に弱っていくんです
column3: Heh... the strange thing is... ever since young Master Liu took a wife, he has grown weaker by the day.

column2: だから、こう言う者がいるんですよ～劉家の若奥様は山の蝶の精が化けたもので、男の精気を吸って生きているんだと
column3: So some folks say that the young mistress of the Liu house is a butterfly spirit from the mountains in human form, who lives by sucking the vital essence out of men.

column2: でたらめ言わないで！　そんな噂、どこから出てきたのよ
column3: What nonsense! Where did these rumors come from?

column2: この目で見たんですよ．．ある晩、劉のお屋敷の花園の裏門あたりを通りかかった時、急に用を足したくなって近くの草むらに隠れたんです．．そうしたら．．劉家の若奥様が珍しい花や草をどっさり抱えて、林の中からこそこそと屋敷へ入っていくのを見たんです。花を食べているところまで、この目で見ましたよ！
column3: I saw it with my own eyes... One night I was passing near the back gate of the Liu garden when nature called, so I ducked into the bushes nearby... and then... I saw the young mistress of the Liu house come out of the woods with her arms full of strange flowers and herbs and slip furtively into the house. I even saw her eating the flowers with my own eyes!

column2: いいわ～お金はあげる。でも警告しておくわよ、そんなでたらめな噂、これ以上誰にも言いふらさないこと
column3: All right, you'll get your money. But I'm warning you: you are not to repeat these wild rumors to anyone ever again.

column2: ほかにも何か聞きたいことはありませんか？　手前の情報はいちばん早いんですよ！　たったの100文で．．
column3: Wouldn't you like to ask about anything else? Nobody is better informed than I am! Only 100 coins...

column2: お代は先払いで．．．．！
column3: Payment first....!

column2: よろしい～おっしゃってください．．何をお知りになりたいんで？
column3: All right, tell me... what is it you want to know?

column2: そうね～あたしたち、女の子を一人捜してるの。年は十六くらい、青い上着に白い長ズボン、きれいな顔立ちで、長いおさげを二本結ってるわ。そんな人を見かけなかった？
column3: Well... we're looking for a girl. About sixteen, wearing a blue top and long white trousers, with delicate features and her hair in two long braids. Have you seen anyone like that?

column2: うむ．．そいつは聞く相手がよかった！　先日、まさにおっしゃる通りの見た目の娘さんが．．かわいそうにねえ～
column3: Mm... you've asked just the right man! A while back there was a girl who looked exactly as you describe... poor thing...

column2: その子は今どこにいるの？　名前は何ていうの？
column3: Where is that girl now? What's her name?

column2: 聞くところによると～その娘さんは家に不幸があって、たった一人で都へ出てきたものの、身寄りには会えず、路頭に迷ったあげく、やくざ者の手に落ちて妓楼に売られたそうで。姓も名も手前は知りません。知っているのは、今の源氏名が"小蓮児"だということだけです
column3: From what I hear, that girl's family met with misfortune and she came to the Capital all alone. She couldn't find her kin, ended up on the streets, fell into the hands of gangsters and was sold to a brothel. What her real name is, I don't know. All I know is that she now goes by "Miss Xiaolian'er".

column2: 今日は商売繁盛だ！
column3: Business is good today!

column2: りゅ．．劉晋元の家って．．尚書府なのか！？
column3: L-Liu Jinyuan's home... is the Minister's residence!?

column2: 当たり前でしょ。劉のおじさまは当代の大学士で、官位は二品の礼部尚書よ。今じゃあちらのお屋敷は、うちより倍も大きいんだから！
column3: Of course. Uncle Liu is a Grand Scholar of the court, a second-rank official and Minister of Rites. These days his house is twice the size of ours!

column2: でも．．俺、役人と付き合うのがいちばん苦手なんだよ．．．．
column3: But... there's nothing I dread more than dealing with officials....

column2: 安心して～あんたをよそ者扱いする人なんていないわ。劉家とうちの林家は代々の付き合いなの。あたしが小さい頃、劉のおじさまがまだ挙人に受かる前は、一家でうちに身を寄せていたのよ。さあ、行きましょ！
column3: Relax, nobody would dare treat you as an outsider. The Lius and we Lins are old family friends. When I was little, before Uncle Liu passed the provincial examination, his whole family lodged in our house. Come on, let's go!

column2: こんな格好で、失礼じゃないかな？
column3: Dressed like this, won't I look disrespectful?

column2: あんたなんか何を着たって同じよ．．田舎のイモなんだから～あはは！
column3: Whatever you wear, you look just the same... a plain country dumpling! Ha ha!

column2: へえ？　ところが、そのイモが大好物っていう深窓のお嬢様もいるんだよなあ
column3: Oh? And yet certain fine young ladies do seem to have a taste for plain dumplings.

column2: ふん、減らず口はやめなさい。誰がイモ好きですって！？
column3: Hmph, enough of your cheek. Who has a taste for dumplings!?

column2: あ．．李様、林お嬢様。晩餐の支度がまだ整っておりません、もうしばらくお待ちください
column3: Ah... Young Master Li, Miss Lin. The banquet is not ready yet. Please wait a little longer.

column2: 厨房で酒と料理の支度がすっかり整いましたら、わたくしが改めてお二人をお呼びに参ります
column3: Once the kitchen has the food and wine all ready, I will come and fetch you both.

column2: 料理はすぐにできますよ！　林お嬢様．．お腹がお空きでしたら、先に軽いものを何かお作りしましょうか
column3: The dishes will be done very soon! Miss Lin... if you are hungry, I can make you a little something first.

column2: いいえ～どうぞ続けて．．あたし、お腹は空いてないから
column3: No, no, you carry on... I'm not hungry.

column2: 私の作る料理は旦那様と奥様の大のお気に入りでしてね。お屋敷でお客様をもてなす時は、奥様はいつも私に腕を振るわせてくださるんです
column3: The Master and Madam are very fond of my cooking. Whenever the household entertains guests, Madam always has me take charge of the kitchen.

column2: 林お嬢様、李様、ごきげんよう
column3: Good day, Miss Lin. Good day, Young Master Li.

column2: 何をしているの？
column3: What are you doing?

column2: お嬢様に申し上げます～この青菜は、育ちすぎた葉や虫に食われたところをきれいに取り除かないと、鍋に入れられないのです
column3: If you please, Miss, with these greens the old leaves and the insect-bitten parts must all be picked out before they can go in the pot.

column2: お出しした料理に余計なものが一つでも入っていたら、私たちは奥様にお叱りを受けてしまいます
column3: If anything that should not be there turns up in a dish we serve, Madam will punish us.

column2: へへ～それなら俺の得意分野だ。手伝おうか？
column3: Hey, that's my specialty. Want me to help?

column2: い～いえ、若様のお手を煩わせるなど、とんでもございません。わたくし一人で大丈夫です
column3: N-no, I would not dare trouble you, sir. I can manage by myself.

column2: 旦那様と奥様はとてもお客好きで、大事なお客様がいらっしゃるたびに、私たちにそれはたくさんの料理を用意させるのです
column3: The Master and Madam are most hospitable. Every time an important guest arrives, they have us prepare a great many dishes.

column2: この青菜と果物は買ってきたばかりで、とても新鮮なんですよ！
column3: These greens and fruit have only just been bought. They are very fresh!

column2: さあさあ、町の皆の衆！　張天師の降魔伏妖の霊符、大安売りじゃ。買うならお早く～数に限りあり。遅れたらもう手に入らんぞ！
column3: Good people, one and all! Celestial Master Zhang's demon-quelling charms, going at bargain prices! Buy now if you're buying... supplies are limited. Come late and you'll miss your chance!

column2: 毎度あり～お宅で驚きを鎮める祈祷や、妖怪退治、風水見立てのご用があれば．．この山人のところへ来れば間違いなしじゃ！
column3: Thank you kindly! Should your household ever need a fright soothed, a demon caught or the feng shui read... just come to this humble hermit!

column2: 林お嬢様、李様．．奥様が、お二人を食堂へお食事にご案内するようにと仰せです
column3: Miss Lin, Young Master Li... Madam has sent me to invite you both to the dining hall for the meal.

column2: 劉兄さんもずいぶん気の毒よね．．
column3: Poor Brother Liu... I do feel sorry for him.

column2: 何が気の毒なもんか。俺はむしろ、劉兄こそいちばんの幸せ者だと思うぜ！
column3: Sorry for him? If you ask me, Brother Liu is the luckiest man alive!

column2: あんなにきれいで貞淑な奥さんに毎日世話してもらえるんだ。俺もあんな嫁さんをもらえたら、死んで幽霊になったって本望だね！
column3: With such a beautiful, virtuous wife looking after him day in, day out... if I could marry a wife like that, I'd die and turn into a ghost a happy man!

column2: じゃあ、さっさと死んじゃいなさいよ。幽霊女でも嫁にもらえば！
column3: Then go right ahead and die! Go and marry yourself a ghost bride!

column2: 冗談だってば．．何もそんなに怒ることないだろ
column3: I was only joking... What are you getting so angry for?

column2: ふん！　あんたなんか相手にしてられないわ
column3: Hmph! I can't be bothered with you.

column2: 李殿、遠慮なさらず～たくさん召し上がってね
column3: Young Master Li, don't stand on ceremony. Eat as much as you like.

column2: ありがとうございます、奥様．．
column3: Thank you, Madam...

column2: そうだわ．．雲おばさま！　どうしてお義姉さんも一緒に食事にお呼びしないの？
column3: Oh, that reminds me... Aunt Yun! Why don't you ask my sister-in-law to dine with us?

column2: それがね．．晋元は病気になってから、少しでも生臭いものや脂っこいものは一切食べられなくて、毎日三度の食事は彩依が別に作っているの。彩依は、夫婦は苦楽を共にするものだと言って、毎日三度とも晋元と同じ精進の薄粥を一緒に食べて、ほかのものは口にしないのよ
column3: Well, you see... since Jinyuan fell ill he cannot eat anything the least bit meaty or greasy, so Caiyi cooks all three of his daily meals separately. Caiyi says husband and wife should share hardship as well as joy, so at every meal she eats the same plain vegetarian fare and thin gruel as Jinyuan, and nothing else.

column2: やめるように言ったのだけれど、あの子がどうしてもと聞かなくて。だからあの夫婦は、もう長いこと私たち年寄り二人と同じ食卓を囲んでいないの
column3: I tried to talk her out of it, but she insisted. So it has been a long time now since the two of them sat at the same table as us two old folks.

column2: 晋元兄さんはどうやってお義姉さんと知り合ったの？　兄さんがお嫁さんをもらったなんて、ついさっき知ったばかりで、本当にびっくりしたわ！
column3: How did Brother Jinyuan come to know my sister-in-law? I only just found out he had taken a wife. It gave me quite a shock!

column2: 彩依はひと月前にここへ来たの。あの時～一家で旅をしてこの辺りまで来たところで盗賊に遭い、両親はどちらも殺されて、あの子だけが運よく逃げのびたのよ
column3: Caiyi came here a month ago. At the time, her family had traveled this far on a journey when they were set upon by bandits. Both her parents were killed, and she alone was lucky enough to escape.

column2: かわいそうに一文無しで身寄りもなく、身を売ってでも両親を葬りたいと、うちに侍女として身を寄せてきたの
column3: The poor girl had not a coin to her name and no one to turn to. She wished to sell herself into service to pay for her parents' burial, and so she came to our house as a maid.

column2: 私と主人は、あの子が読み書きも礼儀もわきまえ、優しくて細やかで、器量もよく、そのうえ医術の心得もあるのを見て、晋元の世話を任せることにしたの
column3: My husband and I saw that she was lettered and well-mannered, gentle and attentive, pretty too, and versed in medicine besides. So I put her in charge of looking after Jinyuan.

column2: 不思議なことに、あの頃の晋元は何やら得体の知れない病にかかって、大勢のお医者様を呼んでも治せなかったの
column3: Strangely enough, at that time Jinyuan had come down with some mysterious illness, and none of the many doctors we called in could cure it.

column2: けれど彩依が来てからは、あの子の世話のおかげで、晋元は日に日によくなっていったのよ．．．
column3: But once Caiyi came, under her care Jinyuan began to improve day by day...

column2: それで二人は結婚したの？
column3: And then they were married?

column2: そうなの．．私としては、晋元に早く祝言を挙げさせて、めでたい事で厄を払えば、薬なしでも治るかもしれないと思ってね
column3: Yes... I thought that if Jinyuan were wed quickly, the happy occasion might drive off his bad luck, and he might recover even without medicine.

column2: まったく、人の弱みにつけ込んで．．
column3: Talk about taking advantage of someone in distress...

column2: 何ですって？
column3: What was that?

column2: いや、その．．まさに天の賜った良縁だなって！
column3: I said... truly a match made in heaven!

column2: 黙って食べてなさい！　余計な口をきかないの
column3: Eat your food! And don't let your mouth run away with you.

column2: 雲おばさま！　李兄さんは都に来るのが初めてなの。あちこち案内してあげたいんだけど
column3: Aunt Yun! This is Brother Li's first time in the Capital. I'd like to take him around to see the sights.

column2: ふふ．．あなたって子は～本当にじっとしていられないのね。いいわ～遊んでいらっしゃい
column3: Hoho... you never could sit still, could you? Go on, then. Off you go and enjoy yourselves.

column2: この都には物騒な場所もあるから、むやみに入り込んではだめよ！
column3: Some parts of this city are rough. Don't go wandering in just anywhere!

column2: うう．．洗うお椀がこんなにたくさん
column3: Sob... so many bowls to wash.

column2: 林お嬢様、李様、ごきげんよう
column3: Good day, Miss Lin. Good day, Young Master Li.

column2: 奥様からの特別なお言いつけで、庭は内も外もすっかり掃き清めなければなりません
column3: Madam gave special orders that the courtyard be swept clean inside and out.

column2: 奥様も若奥様もたいへんきれい好きで、地面に落ち葉一枚残してはいけないのです
column3: Madam and the Young Madam are both very particular about cleanliness. Not a single fallen leaf may be left on the ground.

column2: こちらは若様と若奥様のお住まいの離れでございます
column3: This is the side chamber where the Young Master and the Young Madam live.

column2: 若奥様と若様はとても仲睦まじいのですよ。若奥様は毎日、ご病気の若様の枕元に付き添って、一歩も離れません
column3: The Young Madam and the Young Master are a most devoted couple. Every day the Young Madam stays at the sick Young Master's bedside and never leaves it for a moment.

column2: 若奥様は毎日ご自分で若様のお食事や湯浴み、お召し替えのお世話をなさるだけでなく、お薬も毎日煎じて、召使いには決して任せません
column3: The Young Madam not only waits on the Young Master in person every day at his meals, his bath and his dressing, she also brews his medicine daily and never lets the servants do it for her.

column2: 時々、若様はお体の具合が悪いせいで癇癪を起こされますが、若奥様は恨み言ひとつおっしゃいません
column3: At times the Young Master loses his temper because he is feeling unwell, yet the Young Madam has never uttered a word of complaint.

column2: 若奥様はたいそう花がお好きで、お部屋の内にも外にも、いろいろな花をいっぱいに植えていらっしゃいます
column3: The Young Madam loves flowers dearly. She has planted all kinds of them inside and outside her rooms.

column2: しかも～若奥様は花を育てる名人でして、庭にたくさん咲き誇っている牡丹は、みな若奥様が手ずから植えたものなのです
column3: What is more, the Young Madam is a master at growing flowers. All these peonies blooming in the garden were planted by her own hand.

column2: 旦那様のご友人の中には、高値を出して何株か買って帰り、鑑賞したいという方も多いのですが、若奥様はどうしてもお譲りになりません
column3: Many of the Master's friends have offered high prices to take a few plants home to admire, but the Young Madam will not part with them on any account.

column2: この牡丹を見くびってはいけませんよ！　世間ではどれも大変な値がつく名品なのです
column3: Don't underestimate these peonies! On the market every one of them is extremely rare and valuable.

column2: 若奥様はお暇な時、花園へ花を眺めにいらっしゃいます
column3: When the Young Madam has a spare moment, she comes to the garden to admire the flowers.

column2: うーん．．いい香りだ！　この花はみんなあんたが植えたのかい？
column3: Mm... what a lovely scent! Did you plant all these flowers yourself?

column2: 若様も牡丹の花がお好きですか？
column3: Are you fond of peonies too, sir?

column2: 美しいものを嫌いな奴なんていないだろ？
column3: Who doesn't love beautiful things?

column2: わあ～ここ、蝶がこんなにたくさん．．きっと花の香りに誘われて来たのね
column3: Wow, so many butterflies here... The scent of the flowers must have drawn them.

column2: ええ．．蝶の命はとても短いものです。ただ、いちばん美しい花のそばを舞い、花が咲くのに寄り添い、花が散るのと共に逝くことができれば、この一生の願いはそれで十分なのです．．．
column3: Yes... a butterfly's life is very short. It asks only to dance beside the loveliest of flowers, to keep them company as they bloom and to pass away as they fade. With that, the wish of its whole life is fulfilled...

column2: この牡丹、美しいでしょう？
column3: These peonies are beautiful, are they not?

column2: 俺が思うに．．劉晋元は、お前が嫁になるのを承知しなかったから、それで病気になったんじゃないのか？
column3: I've been thinking... didn't Liu Jinyuan fall ill because you refused to marry him?

column2: あたし．．あたしに何の関係があるのよ！？
column3: Me... what has it got to do with me!?

column2: そうとも言い切れないぜ。どうも俺たち、あいつに借りがあるような気がしてさ．．
column3: You can't just say that. I can't help feeling we owe him something...

column2: 晋元兄さんとあたしは確かに小さい頃から一緒に育ったけど、だからってあたしがあの人に恋心を持たなきゃいけないわけじゃないわ。あたしはあの人を実の兄だと思ってるだけよ
column3: Brother Jinyuan and I did grow up together, but that doesn't mean I have to feel any kind of love for him. I only think of him as my own big brother.

column2: 向こうはそうは思ってないぜ！　蘇州にいた時、あいつはお前の親父さんに面と向かって、お前を嫁にくれと頼んでたんだから．．
column3: He doesn't see it that way! Back in Suzhou he asked your father to his face to give him your hand...

column2: お父様が承知したからって何だっていうのよ。言っとくけど、あたしはずっと劉晋元を自分の兄さんだと思ってきたの。信じるかどうかは勝手よ！
column3: So what if my father had agreed? I'm telling you, I have always thought of Liu Jinyuan as my own brother. Believe it or not, as you please!

column2: お父様！！　ど．．どうしてここへ？
column3: Father!! Wh... what are you doing here?

column2: わしは自分の娘を捜しに来たのじゃ～何か悪いか？
column3: I came looking for my own daughter. Is there something wrong with that?

column2: あたし、絶対に帰らないから！
column3: I am not going back!

column2: 月如．．お父様に向かって、そんな口のきき方がありますか
column3: Yueru... how can you speak to your father in such a manner?

column2: お父様ったら、あの手この手であたしを無理やり嫁がせようとしたかと思えば、今度は逍遥兄さんを追い出そうとするのよ
column3: First Father tries every trick he knows to force me to marry, and the next moment he wants to drive Brother Xiaoyao away.

column2: 言うことがころころ変わって、娘の気持ちなんてまるで考えてないじゃない！
column3: He goes back on his own word and doesn't care a bit how his daughter feels!

column2: 私は．．お父様はあなたのためを思ってのことだと思うわ
column3: I think... your father has your own good at heart.

column2: そんなわけないわ！　．．そうだ
column3: Like fun he does! ...Wait a moment.

column2: お父様はどうしてあたしがここにいるって分かったの？　雲おばさま、まさかお父様に告げ口したんじゃ
column3: How did Father know I was here? Aunt Yun, did you go and tell on me?

column2: ふん～告げ口など要るものか！　父親たるわしが、お前の気性を分かっておらんとでも思うか？
column3: Hmph, who needs to be told! Do you think your own father does not know your temper well enough?

column2: 小さい頃から～お前はしくじりをして父に叱られるのが怖くなるたび、雲おばさんのところへ逃げ込んで、とりなしてもらっておったではないか
column3: Ever since you were small, whenever you did wrong and feared a scolding from me, you would run and hide at your Aunt Yun's so that she would plead for you.

column2: 雲おばさんはもう都へ移ってしまったが、父には見当がつく。お前が今度家を飛び出したなら、必ず雲おばさんを訪ねるとな
column3: Your Aunt Yun has since moved to the Capital, but I could guess easily enough that, running away from home this time, you would surely come to her.

column2: 林兄さん～月如はもう子供ではありませんわ。あの子にはあの子の考えがあるのです。私たち年長の者が、あまりあの子たちを困らせることもないでしょう
column3: Brother Lin, Yueru is not a child anymore. She has a mind of her own. We elders need not make things too hard for them.

column2: 雲さん、安心なされ．．わしが今日ここへ来たのは、ある事を確かめるためで、この子らを責めるつもりではない
column3: Sister Yun, set your mind at rest... I came here today only to make sure of one thing, not to take them to task.

column2: 月如！　父が聞く．．お前は家を出てからのこの日々、ずっとあの男と一緒だったのか？
column3: Yueru! Answer your father... all these days since you left home, have you been with him the whole time?

column2: そ．．そうだったらどうなのよ。あたしと李兄さんの間は潔白よ
column3: Y-yes... and what if I have? There is nothing improper between Brother Li and me.

column2: 李少侠．．あの婿選びの試合は、今でも有効としてよい。ただし．．一つだけ約束してもらいたい
column3: Young hero Li... the outcome of that contest for her hand can still stand, provided... that you promise me one thing.

column2: 今後二度とあの趙という蛇妖の娘を捜しに行かぬと誓うなら、わしは直ちに月如をおぬしに嫁がせよう
column3: So long as you never again go looking for that snake demoness named Zhao, I will give you Yueru's hand at once.

column2: ．．．．．．．．　．．申し訳ありませんが、それには従えません！
column3: ........ ...Forgive me, sir, but that I cannot obey!

column2: 情から言っても道理から言っても、私は霊児を見捨てるわけにはいきません
column3: By feeling and by reason alike, I cannot abandon Ling'er.

column2: ならば、わしの娘を何だと思っておる！　．．．おぬしの付き人か！？
column3: Then what do you take my daughter for! ...Your hanger-on!?

column2: 先輩～それとこれとは別の話で．．
column3: Master, those are two different matters...

column2: お父様～あたしたちのことは、放っておいてよ！
column3: Father, please stay out of our affairs!

column2: 黙れ！　実の娘が外で男とふらふら遊び歩くのを、放っておけるものか！？
column3: Silence! How can I let my own flesh-and-blood daughter roam about carrying on with a man!?

column2: お父様！　どうしてそんなひどい言い方をするの
column3: Father! How can you put it in such an ugly way!

column2: もうよい～親子で言い争うのはやめじゃ。これ以上何を言っても、お前が聞かぬことは父にも分かっておる
column3: Enough. Let us not quarrel, father and daughter. I know that whatever more I say, you will not listen.

column2: 李少侠～二人きりで少し話したいことがあるのじゃが、よいかな？
column3: Young hero Li, there are a few words I would like to speak with you in private. May I?
Very well....

column2: お父様はどうしてまた急に行ってしまわれたの？
column3: Why did your father go off again so suddenly?

column2: はあ．．本当は林兄さんも、深く心を砕いているのよ
column3: Sigh... The truth is, Brother Lin means well and has taken great pains over this.

column2: 劉晋元は眠っている．．
column3: Liu Jinyuan is asleep...

column2: 李少侠、おぬしも、わしがあの時一方的に婚約を取り消したことを恨んでおるのではないか？
column3: Young hero Li, do you too bear me a grudge for breaking off the betrothal on my own back then?

column2: 滅相もありません。あなたは月如の父上です。月如のことはあなたがお決めになること、私が恨み言など言えるはずがありません．．
column3: I would not dare. You are Yueru's father, and her affairs are yours to decide. How could I presume to complain...

column2: ふん．．．月如もおぬしのように物分かりがよければのう
column3: Hmph... If only Yueru were as sensible as you.

column2: わしとて約束を破り、わざと邪魔立てしておるのではない。ただ～おぬしとあの趙という娘の仲がどうも曖昧に見えるのでな。あの娘が正か邪かはさておき
column3: It is not that I am faithless to my word or bent on standing in your way. Rather, I see that you and that Miss Zhao are on ambiguous terms. Leaving aside whether she is righteous or evil,

column2: 月如がおりながら、心でほかの女を気にかけるなど、あってはならんことじゃ
column3: you ought not, having Yueru, still carry another woman in your heart.

column2: 愚か者の言とお許しください～私は、男子たるもの天地の間に立つからには、情もあり、義もなくてはならないと思っています
column3: Forgive my foolishness, but I believe a true man who stands between heaven and earth must have both feeling and honor.

column2: 霊児は哀れな身の上で、おばからは、彼女を苗疆の故郷まで送り届けて母親を捜させるようにと、くれぐれも言いつかっています。それに霊児とは先に出会い、命を救ってもらった恩もあります。もし私が権勢や富にすがるために彼女を見捨てたら、それこそ不仁、不義、不孝の人間ではありませんか！？
column3: Ling'er's lot is a pitiable one, and my aunt charged me again and again to escort her back to her home in the Miao lands to find her mother. Moreover I met Ling'er first, and she once saved my life. If I abandoned her in order to rise in the world by clinging to the rich and powerful, would I not be a man without kindness, without honor and without filial duty!?

column2: 口だけは達者じゃな。だが．．このまま、わしの娘をはっきりせぬ立場でおぬしに付いて行かせよと言うのか？！
column3: Fine-sounding words, but... am I to let my daughter go on trailing after you like this, with no name and no standing?!

column2: もう言うな、剣を抜け！　見せてもらおう～おぬしが真の男子か、それとも口先だけのごろつきか
column3: Say no more. Draw your sword! I mean to see whether you are truly a man, or merely a scoundrel who is all talk.

column2: いえ～あなたに手向かいするなど、私にはとても？！
column3: No! How could I dare raise my hand against you?!

column2: わしは本気じゃ～受けてみよ！　おぬしに真の腕と真の胆力があるなら、半歩たりとも退かずに、わが林家の七訣剣気を受けきってみせい
column3: I am in earnest. Defend yourself! If you have real skill and real courage, then without falling back even half a step, stand and take my Lin family's Seven Sword Qi!

column2: おぬしがわしに勝てば、今後、わしはおぬしらのことに口を出さぬ
column3: If you can beat me, from this day on I will ask no more about the affairs of you two.

column2: 逆に～おぬしが臆病な鼠輩であったなら、この場で一太刀のもとに斬り捨ててくれる。娘の一生を誤らせぬためにな！
column3: But if you turn out to be a cowardly rat, I will strike you dead with one stroke on the spot, lest you ruin my daughter's whole life!

column2: はあ．．！　わしも本当に老いたものじゃ
column3: Ah...! I truly have grown old.

column2: お父様．．！
column3: Father...!

column2: 李兄さん！　怪我はない？
column3: Brother Li! Are you hurt?

column2: もうよい．．もうよい．．娘というものは、育て上げれば結局は人のものになるのじゃな
column3: So be it... so be it... Raise a daughter, and in the end she belongs to someone else.
Master...!

column2: 月如は幼い頃から甘やかされて育ち、苦労を知らぬ。どうかよく面倒を見てやってくれ
column3: Yueru has been pampered since she was small and has never known hardship. I hope you will take good care of her.

column2: お前の親父さん．．やっぱりお前のことを気にかけてるんだな
column3: Your father... he does still care about you a great deal.

column2: 分かってるわ．．．でも．．あたしはもう大人なんだから、独り立ちするべきだと思うの。一生親に頼って生きるわけにはいかないもの
column3: I know... but... I think I've grown up now and ought to stand on my own. I can't lean on my parents all my life.

column2: 本当に家へ帰らないつもりなのか？
column3: Do you really mean never to go home?

column2: あたし、今みたいな暮らしが好きなの。あちこちを旅して、冒険して．．たくさんの人や物事に出会えるし、それに自分の武芸も鍛えられるわ
column3: I like living the way I do now. Traveling everywhere, having adventures... I get to meet so many people and see so many things, and I can hone my martial arts too.

column2: それに．．．
column3: And besides...

column2: そうすれば、あんたと一緒にいられるもの
column3: this way I can be with you.

column2: 俺は学も芸もないただの風来坊だぜ。俺に付いてきて、そのうち二人そろって物乞いになっても知らないぞ？
column3: I'm just a drifter with no learning and no skills. If you stick with me, aren't you afraid we'll both end up begging for our supper?

column2: もし本当にそうなったら、あたしの運が悪かったってことね！
column3: If it really comes to that, I'll just have my own bad luck to blame!

column2: よし～霊児の行方を見つけて
column3: All right. Once I've found out where Ling'er is

column2: 何もかも片がついたら、お前を連れてあちこち山水を巡ろう。一緒に天下の珍味を食べ尽くして、この世の絶景を見尽くすんだ
column3: and everything is settled, I'll take you to see the mountains and rivers everywhere. Together we'll eat our way through every delicacy under heaven and feast our eyes on all the beauty of this world.

column2: ふふ．．年を取るまで食べて！　年を取るまで遊ぶのね！
column3: Hee hee... eating till we're old! Playing till we're old!

column2: じゃあ．．俺たち．．．．
column3: Then... the two of us....

column2: きゃっ．．！！
うわっ！？　奥さん．．急に出てくるから、びっくりしたじゃないか
column3: Whoa!? Ma'am... you popped up so suddenly, you gave me a fright.

column2: は、はい．．本当に申し訳ございません．．道を急いでおりまして、ご挨拶もせずに
column3: Y-yes... I am truly sorry... I was hurrying on my way and did not stop to greet you.

column2: 奥さんは花を摘みに外へ出てきたのかい？
column3: Have you come out to pick flowers, ma'am?

column2: はい．．
column3: Yes...

column2: ということは、この林にはきれいな野の花がたくさん咲いてるのね？！
column3: So that means lots of pretty wildflowers grow in these woods?!

column2: やった、逍遥兄さん～あたしも摘みに行きたい！
column3: Lovely! Brother Xiaoyao, I want to go and pick some too!

column2: い．．いけません．．
column3: N-no... you must not...

column2: どうしていけないの？！
column3: Why not?!

column2: 行こうよ～逍遥兄さん、一緒に行きましょ
column3: Come on, Brother Xiaoyao, let's go together.

column2: それは．．この林には．．毒蜘蛛がたくさんおりますし、毒を持つ草花もございます。
column3: Because... in these woods... there are many poisonous spiders, and some of the plants and flowers are poisonous too.

column2: 万が一．．うっかり触れてしまわれたら、毒に当たるかもしれません
column3: If by some chance... you were to touch one by accident, you could be poisoned.

column2: 奥さんのほうがこの辺りには詳しいんだ。月如～それなら行くのはやめとこうぜ。花を摘むなら、庭にいくらでもあるだろ
column3: She knows this place better than we do. Yueru, in that case let's not go. If it's flowers you want, there are plenty in the garden.

column2: 申し訳ございません．．旦那様が、わたくしが戻ってお薬を煎じるのを待っておりますので、これで失礼いたします
column3: Forgive me... my husband is waiting for me to come back and brew his medicine. I must take my leave.

column2: どうやら．．お義姉さんは、よくこの林へ珍しい花や草を採りに来ているみたいね
column3: It looks as though... my sister-in-law often comes to these woods to gather rare flowers and herbs.

column2: どうりでいつも体からうっとりするような花の香りがするわけだ。しょっちゅう花に触れてるせいかもな！
column3: No wonder there's always that intoxicating scent of flowers about her. Maybe it comes from handling flowers so often!

column2: 旦那様．．お願いでございます．．このお薬をお飲みください。そうすれば、ご病気も早くよくなりますから．．
column3: My husband... I beg of you... please drink this medicine. Then your illness will be cured all the sooner...

column2: ああ！　旦那様．．あなた．．
column3: Ah! My husband... you...

column2: お前が毎日私に飲ませている薬は、私の病を治すためのものなどではなく、眠り薬なのだろう！？
column3: The medicine you give me to drink every day is not meant to cure my illness at all. It is a sleeping drug, is it not!?

column2: 旦那様．．な．．なぜそのようなことを。このお薬はわたくしが苦労を重ねて採ってきたもの、世の中でこの処方だけが旦那様を治せるのです．．
column3: My husband... wh-why would you say such a thing? I gathered these herbs with great toil, and this is the only remedy in the world that can cure you...

column2: ふん！　私の病には、どの医者も手の施しようがなかった。それが、お前がどこで手に入れたとも知れぬ怪しげな処方で効くというのか！？
column3: Hmph! Every doctor was helpless before my illness. Do you mean to tell me that some folk remedy you picked up who knows where is going to work!?

column2: それに～なぜ私はこの薬を飲むと、何刻も眠り込んで正体をなくすのだ？
column3: And besides, why is it that whenever I drink this medicine I fall into a dead sleep for hours on end?

column2: 答えろ！　毎晩私が眠り込んでいる間、お前はどこへ行っていた？
column3: Answer me! Every night while I lie in that stupor, where is it you run off to?

column2: わたくし．．わたくしがそのような！
column3: I... how could I ever do such a thing!

column2: 父上と母上は騙せても、私は騙せないぞ。婚礼から今日まで、お前は一度も私と床を共にしていない。お前の目には、私などただの廃人にしか見えていないのだろう！？
column3: You may fool Father and Mother, but you cannot fool me. From our wedding to this day you have never once shared my bed. In your eyes I am nothing but a useless cripple, am I not!?

column2: 旦那様．．そのようなことは．．ご病気が治られましたら、わたくしは当然．．当然．．お仕えいたしますから
column3: My husband... as for that... once you are well again, I will of course... of course... serve you as a wife should.

column2: まだある～！　お前は、両親は蘇州の船商人で、一家で旅に出て盗賊に遭い、落ちぶれて都へ流れ着いたと言ったな
column3: And there is more! You said your parents were ship merchants of Suzhou, that your whole family went traveling and met with bandits, and that this was how you came to be stranded in the Capital.

column2: お前の言ったことは、すべて人をやって調べさせた。結果は、どれもお前の作り話だった。言え！　お前はまだどれだけのことを私に隠している？！
column3: I had people look into everything you told me, and it turned out you made it all up. Speak! How much more are you hiding from me?!

column2: 旦那様．．どうかわたくしを信じてください。わたくしのすることは、何もかも旦那様のためなのです
column3: My husband... please believe me. Everything I do, I do for you.

column2: お願いでございます、残りのお薬をお飲みください！　足りない分は、わたくしがまた採って参ります
column3: I beg you, drink the rest of the medicine! Whatever is still lacking, I will go and gather.

column2: あと三日だけ．．最後のこの三日分のお薬を飲み終えれば、ご病気はすっかりよくなるのです
column3: Only three more days... once you have taken these last three days of medicine, your illness will be completely cured.

column2: 黙れ！　あんな素性の知れぬ薬など、二度と飲むものか
column3: Be silent! I will never drink that medicine of unknown origin again.

column2: 旦那様．．なぜそこまでご自分を苦しめるのです．．
column3: My husband... why must you do this to yourself...

column2: もうお前のことは信じない。父上と母上に話す！
column3: I do not trust you anymore. I am going to tell Father and Mother!

column2: 父上と母上を呼んでこい．．早く！
column3: Go and fetch my father and mother... quickly!

column2: お前．．何をする気だ！？
column3: You... what are you going to do!?
You....

column2: お許しください．．旦那様。わたくしは、こうするほかないのです
column3: Forgive me... my husband. I have no choice but to do this.

column2: どうしてこんなことに！？
column3: How could this happen!?

column2: 二人は劉晋元を起こした．．
column3: The two of them wake Liu Jinyuan...

column2: 月如、また助けてもらったね、ありがとう
column3: Yueru, thank you for saving me once again.

column2: 君もその目で見ただろう！　あの女は～よ．．妖術を使うんだ
column3: You saw it with your own eyes too! That woman... sh-she can work sorcery.

column2: 私は前から、あれは人間ではないと疑っていた。きっと妖怪で、私を害しに来たんだ！
column3: I have long suspected she is not human. She must be a demon, come to do me harm!

column2: 劉兄さん！　真相がまだはっきりしないうちは、むやみに決めつけちゃだめよ。きっとお義姉さんのことを誤解してるんだわ
column3: Brother Liu! Until the truth is known, you mustn't jump to wild conclusions. I'm sure you've misjudged my sister-in-law.

column2: 月如！　私を信じてくれ。この縁談は父上と母上が勝手に決めたもので、私は彼女に一度も情を抱いたことがない。
column3: Yueru! You must believe me. This marriage was arranged by Father and Mother on their own. I have never had any feeling for her.

column2: 君は知っているか．．この日々、私がどれほど苦しんできたかを？
column3: Do you know... how I have suffered all this time?

column2: でも．．劉兄さん．．だからって、お義姉さんがあなたに尽くしてきたことまで否定しちゃいけないわ
column3: But... Brother Liu... you can't let that blot out all the kindness she has shown you.

column2: あんなものはみな偽りだ！　私は朝から晩まで彼女と共にいる。あの振る舞いは、どう見てもまともな人間のものではない！
column3: All of that is false! I am with her from morning till night. However I look at it, the way she behaves is not that of a normal person!

column2: 劉兄さん、落ち着いて．．
column3: Brother Liu, calm down...

column2: そうだ、父上と母上に相談しに行こう！
column3: Yes, I must go and consult Father and Mother!

column2: 待ってくれ！　劉兄．．
column3: Wait! Brother Liu...

column2: 月如、俺たちも付いて行ってみよう！
column3: Yueru, let's follow him and see!

column2: まあ！　晋元、外はこんなに風が強いのに、出てきたりしてはだめでしょう。彩依は？　彩依はどうして付き添っていないの？
column3: Good heavens! Jinyuan, with the wind blowing so hard outside, how could you come running out? Where is Caiyi? Why is Caiyi not with you?

column2: 母上！　早く父上を呼び戻して、裁きをつけてもらってください。
column3: Mother! Quickly, send for Father to come home and settle this.

column2: お父様はまだお戻りではないのよ．．いったいどんな大事が起きたというの？
column3: Your father has not come home yet... Whatever has happened?

column2: 母上～私を助けてください。彩依が．．あの女が私を害そうとしているんです！
column3: Mother, you must save your son. Caiyi... she means to do me harm!

column2: 何ということを言うの！？　彩依がどうしてあなたを害したりするの？
column3: What a thing to say!? Why would Caiyi want to harm you?

column2: 彩依は．．あ．．あれは妖怪です！　妖術を使うんです、私を殺すつもりなんです
column3: Caiyi... sh-she... she is a demon! She can work sorcery, and she means to kill your son!

column2: そんなはずがないでしょう．．！？　かわいそうな子～きっと体の具合が悪くて、少し気が動転しているのよ．．
column3: How could that be...!? My poor child... You must be feeling unwell, and so your mind is a little confused...

column2: 母の言うことを聞いて～部屋へ戻って横になりなさい。蓮の実と燕の巣のスープを二人分煮込んであるから、あなたと彩依の滋養にね
column3: Listen to your mother. Go back to your room and lie down. I have stewed two servings of lotus seed and bird's nest soup to build up your strength and Caiyi's.

column2: 嫌だ！　あそこへは戻らない。薬も飲まない、飲めば死んでしまう。私は殺されてしまうんだ！！
column3: No! I will not go back there. I will not take that medicine. I will die... I will be murdered!!

column2: 奥様．．わたくしの考えでは、若様は悪夢からまだ覚めきっていらっしゃらないか、何かに怯えていらっしゃるのかもしれません
column3: Madam... if I may say so, perhaps the Young Master has not yet fully woken from a nightmare, or perhaps he has had a fright.

column2: ええ．．その通りね～では、どうすればいいのかしら？
column3: Mm... you are right. Then what is to be done?

column2: 道士をお呼びして、若様のために法術で驚きを鎮めていただくのがよろしいかと。わたくしの故郷では、こういう症状の出た者は、みなそうして治りました
column3: We could ask a "Taoist priest" to perform a rite to soothe the Young Master's fright. In my home village, people who showed these symptoms were all cured that way.

column2: あなたたちは先に若様を私の部屋へお連れして。この件は私に考えがあります
column3: Take the Young Master to my room for now. I will decide what to do about this.

column2: はい！
column3: Yes, Madam!

column2: 若様！　どうぞ．．
column3: Young Master! This way, please...

column2: はあ．．主人も留守だし、本当にどうしたらいいのか分からないわ
column3: Sigh... and with my husband away, I truly do not know what to do.

column2: 月如、李殿．．あなたたちは世間を広く見ているわ。この件、私の代わりにどうすべきか決めてもらえないかしら？
column3: Yueru, Young Master Li... you two have seen much of the world. Could I ask you to decide for me what should be done?

column2: 分かったわ．．雲おばさま、安心して！　あたしたち、必ず力になるから
column3: Of course... don't worry, Aunt Yun! We will certainly help you.

column2: 先にお二人にお礼を申し上げますわ．．
column3: Let me thank you both in advance...

column2: 若奥様は若様と言い争いをなさった後、どこへ行かれたのか分かりません
column3: After quarreling with the Young Master, the Young Madam went off, and no one knows where.

column2: わたくしも若奥様には少し妙なところがあると思います。でも．．若奥様の若様へのお気持ちは、間違いなく本物です
column3: I too think there is something a little odd about the Young Madam. But... her feelings for the Young Master are surely sincere.

column2: わたくしも、若奥様がとてもお気の毒だと思います．．
column3: I feel so sorry for the Young Madam too...

column2: 若奥様がお気の毒で．．
column3: The poor Young Madam...

column2: お金が入り用なら、遠慮なく雲おばさまに言ってちょうだい
column3: If you need money, don't hesitate to ask your Aunt Yun.

column2: 30000文を手に入れた
column3: Got 30000 coins

column2: それでは．．何もかもお願いするわね
column3: Well then... I leave everything in your hands.

column2: まだお金が入り用なの？
column3: Do you need more money?

column2: 晋元を救えるのなら、いくらかかってもかまわないわ
column3: So long as Jinyuan can be saved, it does not matter how much it costs.

column2: 30000文を手に入れた
column3: Got 30000 coins

column2: それでは．．お願いするわね
column3: Well then... I am counting on you.

column2: お金がまだ足りないの？
column3: Is the money still not enough?

column2: かまわないわ～私のところにまだあるから．．
column3: Never mind. I still have more here...

column2: 30000文を手に入れた
column3: Got 30000 coins

column2: 道士を呼んで．．効き目があるのかしら？
column3: Calling in a Taoist priest... will it do any good?

column2: 金を揃えてから出直してくるんじゃな！
column3: Come back and see me when you've scraped the money together!

column2: この山人に法術を頼みたいとな。それなら、まさにうってつけの相手を見つけたぞ！
column3: You wish to have this humble hermit perform a rite? Then you have come to just the right man!

column2: この茅山道人が出向きさえすれば、災いあれば災いを払い、難あれば難を解く。いかなる妖魔鬼怪、悪霊魑魅も、残らず正体を暴かれるのじゃ！
column3: Once I, the Taoist of Maoshan, take the field, calamities are dispelled and troubles resolved. No demon or monster, no evil spirit or goblin, will have anywhere left to hide!

column2: 思えば昔～わしと師匠の太乙真人が手を組んで陰山鬼姥と戦った時、師匠はたったの一手で．．
column3: Why, back in the day, when my master the Immortal Taiyi and I joined forces against the Ghost Crone of Mount Yin, my master used just one move and...

column2: はいはい～分かったわよ。道長がそれほど法力のお高い方なら、あたしたちと一緒に劉尚書のお屋敷まで来て、劉尚書の若様の驚きを鎮めてもらえない？
column3: All right, all right, I get the idea. Since your powers are so profound, Reverend, would you come with us to Minister Liu's residence and soothe the fright of the Minister's son?

column2: ほう．．尚書の若様か。それなら値は少々張るぞ．．
column3: Oho... the Minister's son, is it? Then the price will be a little higher...

column2: いくら？　言ってちょうだい！
column3: How much? Name it!

column2: ほっほ．．こういうことじゃ。普段～貧しい家なら事情を見て、最大で半値まで負けてやる～善行じゃからな
column3: Heh... it's like this. Usually, for poor households I take their circumstances into account and give as much as half off. A good deed, you understand.

column2: 高官や豪商となると．．わが開祖の定めた決まり通りにいただくことになる．．ふむ．．どれ、勘定してみよう．．
column3: But for high officials and rich merchants... I go by the rule laid down by the founder of our sect... Hmm... let me work it out...

column2: 一万五千、びた一文負からん！
column3: Fifteen thousand, and not a coin less!

column2: 商談成立じゃ！
column3: It's a deal!

column2: ふむ．．ふむ．．．。
column3: Hmm... hmm....

column2: 劉の若様は両の目が青みを帯び、経脈は腫れ、眉間には紫黒の気が凝っておる．．十中八九、きわめて強力な巫毒にやられておるな
column3: Young Master Liu's eyes have a greenish cast, his meridians are swollen, and a purple-black aura has gathered between his brows... Nine chances in ten he has been struck by an extremely potent witch-poison.

column2: 巫毒？！
column3: Witch-poison?!

column2: 巫毒というのは～呪術に毒蠱を合わせて、人の体に仕掛けるものじゃ
column3: What we call witch-poison is a curse combined with a venomous Gu and laid upon a person's body.

column2: 道行のきわめて高い巫蠱師か、毒物が化けた精怪でなければ、この手の邪術は使えん。
column3: Only a Gu sorcerer of very great attainment, or a spirit transformed from some poisonous creature, can work this kind of black art.

column2: 普通．．この毒に当たれば、毒を仕掛けた者にしか解けんのじゃ
column3: As a rule... once someone is struck by this poison, only the one who laid it can undo it.

column2: では．．うちの息子は．．うちの息子はまだ助かるのでしょうか．．？
column3: Then... my son... can my son still be saved...?

column2: 何とも言えんな．．劉の若様の体内には、どうやら別の正体不明の毒があって、巫蠱の毒性を抑え込んでおるようじゃ。しばらくの間は毒が回ることはあるまい
column3: Hard to say... Inside Young Master Liu's body there seems to be another, unknown poison that is holding the Gu poison in check. For the time being the poison should not take effect.

column2: じゃが～奇妙なのは．．普通の者がこのような毒を二種も同時に受ければ、たとえ毒が回らずとも、七日と経たぬうちに元気が枯れ果てて死んでおるはずなのじゃ
column3: But the strange thing is... if an ordinary man were struck by two such poisons at once, then even if neither took effect, his vital energy would be drained dry and he would be dead within seven days.

column2: 劉の若様の脈から推すに、毒を受けてから少なくともひと月以上は経っておる．．何かたいそうな滋養の仙丹でも飲んだのか、よくぞ今まで持ちこたえたものじゃ！？
column3: Judging by Young Master Liu's pulse, he was poisoned at least a month ago... Has he been taking some mighty restorative elixir, that he has managed to hold out until now!?

column2: い．．いいえ。道長～お見立て違いではございませんか？　あの時からは、うちの嫁が薬草を煎じて息子に飲ませているだけなのです
column3: N-no, nothing of the kind. Reverend, could you be mistaken? Ever since then, the only thing he has had is the herbal brew my daughter-in-law makes for him.

column2: ほかのお医者様の出した薬は、息子が飲むと吐いてしまうので、もう飲ませておりません
column3: The medicines the other doctors prescribed made my son vomit whenever he took them, so we stopped giving them to him.

column2: 事はそう単純ではないな。思うに～劉の若様が普段お住まいの部屋を調べてみねばなるまい．．
column3: This is no simple matter. I think I must go and examine the room where Young Master Liu usually lives...

column2: おおっ．．何と濃い妖気じゃ。妖怪は間違いなくこの近くにおるぞ！
column3: Oho... what a heavy demonic aura! The demon is surely somewhere close by!

column2: 道長．．どうか何とかしてくださいませ
column3: Reverend... please, think of something.

column2: ご安心なされ～この山人、備えは万全じゃ
column3: Never fear. This humble hermit has come prepared.

column2: リン～　リン～　リン．．
column3: Ding... ding... ding...

column2: 天霊霊、地霊霊\n四方の神々よ、わが命を聞け．．
column3: Spirits of heaven, spirits of earth,\ngods of the four quarters, heed my command...
Mm!?
This....!?

column2: 道長、どうなさいました？
column3: Reverend, what is the matter?

column2: おお．．何でもない．．何でもないぞ！
column3: Oh... nothing... nothing at all!

column2: 見ておれ～張天師の金剛降魔符じゃ！
column3: Now watch this: Celestial Master Zhang's Vajra Demon-Subduing Charm!

column2: おや！？
column3: Eh!?

column2: 不届きな妖魔め、この天師をからかうとは。さっさと正体を現さぬか！
column3: Insolent fiend, you dare make sport of this Celestial Master! Show your true form at once!

column2: わしが本気を出しても恨むでないぞ！
column3: Don't blame me now if I show you what I can really do!

column2: 太上老君、急急如律令\n天兵天将、速やかに降臨せよ！
column3: Supreme Lord Lao, swiftly, by this decree!\nHeavenly soldiers and generals, descend with all speed!

column2: うわあ．．助けてくれえ！
column3: Waaah... help me!

column2: 道長！　道長．．
column3: Reverend! Reverend...

column2: ひいい～わしはまだ命が惜しい！　ほかの腕利きを当たってくれ
column3: Aaah, I still want to live! Go and find someone more capable!

column2: どうしましょう！　晋元にもしものことがあったら、劉家のご先祖様方にどう申し開きをすればいいの．．
column3: What am I to do! If anything should happen to my Jinyuan, how will I ever answer to the ancestors of the Liu family...

column2: 大金をはたいて、呼んだのがあんな間抜けだなんて！？
column3: We spent a pile of silver, and all it got us was that fool!?

column2: 今度の相手は、本当にとんでもなく手ごわい妖怪なのかもしれないな。しかも、この尚書府の中に潜んでるんだ
column3: It may be that this time we're truly up against a very powerful demon, and what's more it's hiding right here in the Minister's residence.

column2: どうしたわけか、若様がまた急に深い眠りに落ちてしまわれました
column3: For some reason the Young Master has suddenly fallen into a deep sleep again.

column2: 奥様のお言いつけで．．誰も若様のお邪魔をしてはならないとのことです
column3: Madam's orders... No one is to disturb the Young Master.

column2: はあ．．どうしましょう．．この子の身にいったい何が起きたというの
column3: Sigh... what shall I do... what on earth has happened to this child?

column2: 何じゃと！？　あの一万五千を返せじゃと！
column3: What!? You want that fifteen thousand back!

column2: わしの梵音鈴も桃木剣もすっかりなくなったんじゃぞ。あの十二枚の天師符だって、一枚千文で買ったものなんじゃ！
column3: My sacred chime bell and my peachwood sword are both gone, and as for those twelve Exorcist Charms, I paid a thousand coins apiece for them!

column2: この商いじゃ、儲けが出ないどころか、髪まで半分焼かれてしもうた！
column3: On this job I not only failed to make a single coin, I got half my hair burned off as well!

column2: おぬしらに弁償を求めんだけでもありがたいと思え。それを金を返せとは！
column3: You should be glad I'm not asking you for compensation. And you actually want a refund!

column2: 何かが飛んで行ったみたい！？
column3: I think something just flew past!?

column2: 俺もはっきりとは見えなかった．．
column3: I didn't get a clear look either...

column2: ん？　ずいぶん濃い花の香りだ
column3: Hm? What a strong scent of flowers.

column2: 牡丹の花の香りだわ．．どうして急にこんなに濃くなったの！？
column3: It's the scent of peonies... Why has it suddenly grown so strong!?

column2: う．．．どうして．．すごく眠い、寝ちゃいそう．．
column3: Mm... why... I feel so drowsy, I want to sleep...

column2: この香り、どうも怪しいぞ．．
column3: There's something odd about this scent...

column2: 月如！　しばらく息を止めろ。急いでここを離れるぞ
column3: Yueru! Hold your breath for now. Let's get out of here as fast as we can.

column2: ここは劉尚書のお屋敷だ
column3: This is the residence of Minister Liu.

column2: 尚書様は朝議に出られて、まだお戻りではない
column3: His Excellency has gone to the morning court session and has not yet returned.

column2: 我々は勤務中だ。人と雑談するわけにはいかん
column3: We are on duty. We may not chat with people.

column2: 奥様のおそばの侍女はみんな美人だが、とりわけ阿香は．．彩依お嬢さんが尚書府に来る前は、ずっとみんなの憧れの的だったんだ
column3: The maids who attend Madam are all beauties, Axiang most of all... Before Miss Caiyi came to the Minister's residence, she was always the one everybody idolized.

column2: だが．．美人といえば．．尚書府一番の飛び切りの美人は、彩依お嬢さんをおいてほかにいないな
column3: But... speaking of beauties... the number one beauty of the Minister's residence can be none other than Miss Caiyi.

column2: はあ．．彩依お嬢さんは来て間もなく、若様に嫁いでしまった。あの時はな～大勢の仲間が失恋したもんだ
column3: Sigh... Miss Caiyi had not been here long before she married the Young Master. Back then, a great many of the lads had their hearts broken.

column2: しっ．．こんな話、奥様に聞かれたら大変だ
column3: Shh... Madam must never hear this kind of talk.

column2: お屋敷の決まりは厳しいんだ。衛兵は奥向きの侍女と言葉を交わしてはならない。掃除や飯炊きの下働きを除けば、奥向きの侍女も勝手に外へ出てはならないんだ
column3: The rules of the household are strict. The guards may not speak with the maids of the inner quarters, and apart from the lowly servants who sweep and cook, the maids of the inner quarters may not go out without leave either.

column2: うう．．それなら仕方ありません
column3: Sob... never mind, then.

column2: 林お嬢様、李様．．手前の頼みを一つ聞いていただけませんか？
column3: Miss Lin, Young Master Li... could you do a small favor for me?

column2: 手前．．手紙が一通ありまして．．そ．．それを．．阿香さんに．．渡していただきたいのです．．
column3: I... I have a letter... and I w-would like to ask you... to give it to Miss Axiang for me...

column2: 恋文を手に入れた
column3: Got Love Letter

column2: お願いします．．決して人に知られないように
column3: I am counting on you... Whatever you do, don't let anyone else find out.

column2: 手前は毎朝、阿香が奥様のお供でお寺へお参りに行く時だけ、こっそり一目見ることができるんです．．
column3: The only time I can steal a glance at her is each morning, when Axiang accompanies Madam to the temple to offer incense...

column2: 今日はどういう風の吹き回しだ？　庭の牡丹の香りが、正門のところまで匂ってくるとは
column3: What wind is blowing today? I can smell the peonies in the garden all the way out here at the main gate.

column2: ここに長く勤めているが、こんなことは初めてだ
column3: I have served here a long time, and this is the first time I have ever come across such a thing.

column2: さっき入っていったあの茅山道士が、泡を食って飛び出していったぞ
column3: That Maoshan Taoist who went in a while ago came running out in a panic.

column2: 尚書様のご命令がなければ、兵士は屋敷の中へ入ってはならんのだ
column3: Without His Excellency's orders, the soldiers may not enter the residence grounds.

column2: 林お嬢様、李様、ごきげんよう
column3: Good day, Miss Lin. Good day, Young Master Li.

column2: 林お嬢様、李様、ごきげんよう
column3: Good day, Miss Lin. Good day, Young Master Li.

column2: これは．．阿輝がわたくしに書いたものですって！？
column3: This... Ahui wrote this to me!?

column2: ありがとうございます．．わたくし．．ここに玉佩があるのですが、わたくしの代わりに阿輝へ返していただけませんか？
column3: Thank you... I... I have a Jade Pendant here. Could you return it to Ahui for me?

column2: これは昨日、あの人が奥様の気づかないうちに、わたくしの提げていた籠の中へこっそり入れたものなのです。
column3: Yesterday, when Madam was not looking, he secretly slipped it into the basket I was carrying.

column2: へえ？　あいつがこっそり入れたって、どうして分かるんだ
column3: Oh? How do you know he was the one who slipped it in?

column2: あの人のほかに誰がいるというのです？　どうかあの人に伝えてください。お気持ちはよく分かりますが、こんな高価な物は受け取れません、と。
column3: Who else could it be? Please tell him this: I understand his feelings, but this is far too valuable, and I cannot accept it.

column2: あのお馬鹿さん～危うくわたくしを破滅させるところでした。奥様が籠の中にこの玉佩が増えているのにお気づきになった時は、生きた心地がしませんでした
column3: That fool nearly got me into terrible trouble. When Madam noticed this Jade Pendant had turned up in the basket, I almost died of fright.

column2: 幸い、さっき道で拾ったものだととっさに嘘をついて、奥様をごまかせましたけれど
column3: Luckily I made up a story that I had just picked it up on the road, and so got it past Madam.

column2: それなら結構です．．でも、お二人にはお礼を申し上げます
column3: Then never mind... but I still want to thank you.

column2: この玉佩は手前のじゃありませんよ！
column3: This Jade Pendant isn't mine!

column2: お前が阿香に贈ったんじゃないのか！　じゃあ、誰が贈ったんだ？
column3: You weren't the one who gave it to Axiang! Then who did?

column2: 手前にも分かりません！
column3: I don't know either!

column2: まさか．．まさかほかにも、阿香に密かに想いを寄せている奴がいるのか！
column3: Could it be... could there be someone else who is secretly in love with Axiang too!

column2: そ．．その玉佩は．．お、俺がこっ．．こっそり阿香に贈ったものなんだ。どうか、それを．．俺に返してくれ．．
column3: Th-that... that Jade Pendant... I g-gave it to Axiang in s-secret. Please... give it back to me...

column2: いい大人の男なら、好きな娘がいれば直接そう言えばいいじゃないか！　なんでそんなにこそこそするんだ？
column3: A big grown man like you... if you like a girl, just tell her straight out! Why go sneaking around like this?

column2: でも～俺は．．いつも．．彼女に会うと．．こ．．言葉が．．出てこなくて
column3: But... I... every time... I see her... I j-just... can't get... the words out.
